answer: Each agent posts a refundable stake earning emission only if it clears random spot-checks: each epoch a beacon sample picks identities that must re-derive their persona key in a hardware enclave against a fresh challenge. Miss once, the stake is slashed. A sybil fleet fights the tide: endless re-proving of every puppet, no economies of scale. Vendor heterogeneity acts as a prism, splitting one fingerprint into detectable spectra; cloned agents cluster like frost on a tundra, dense and easy to prune. Cost per fake identity stays linear; marginal profit goes negative.
